result.title: Schedule for BE/BTech Hostel Allocation
result.summary: The partial document outlines the schedule and process for hostel allocation for BE/BTech first-year students. The new session begins on August 3, 2026, with hostel allocation occurring offline from July 28 to August 1, 2026. Candidates must fill out their hostel preferences online by July 20, 2026, and will be called for allocation based on their JEE Main 2026 merit. Those who miss their scheduled time or fail to submit preferences will be allocated hostels last, subject to availability. Fees must be paid on the spot, and room allocation occurs the same day. Provisional admissions will be confirmed after document verification in September 2026. Candidates must ensure the accuracy of their information on the portal and report discrepancies immediately. The venue for the allocation process includes specific locations for allocation, fee deposit, and hostel reporting.
result.text:
Schedule for BE/BTech Hostel Allocation  
 
The hostel allotment process for BE/BTech first year shall be as under:  
 
1. New session is starting w.e.f. 3rd August, 202 6. Hostel allocation will be done  in offline mode  during  
28th July, 202 6 – 1st August, 202 6. Interested candidates are required to physically appear for th is 
process . 
2. Candidates who are interested in opting for the hostel, are required to fill their hostel choice by 
clicking on ‘Hostel Choice’ link available at https://webkiosk.thapar.edu/Admission/index.jsp  Last 
date to exercise this option is 20th July, 202 6. 
3. Candidates will be called on the basis of JEE Main – 2026 merit for the hostel allocation process.  
4. If a candidate fail ed to report on the scheduled date and time, he/she will be allocated a hostel 
at the end of th at day subject to availability.  
5. Candidates who failed to give hostel choice as per point – 2, will be given hostel in the last on 1st  
August, 2026 subject  to availability.  
6. Candidates will be required to pay for the hostel and mess fee on the spot. Detailed fee structure 
is available on the website https://admission.thapar.edu . 
7. Candidates will be allotted room on the same day of hostel allocation. After occupying the room 
if the candidate does not stay in the room without approval of the competent authority, his/her 
room allocation will be cancelled.  
8. All admissions offered till date are provisional. This provisional admission will be confirmed only 
after the document verification  to be held tentatively in September, 202 6.  
9. Following information is available in candidate’s hostel choice page on the portal.  Please ensure 
the correctness of this information.  
 
a. 10+2 PCM Score  
b. JEE Main – 2026 Percentile (Best of two) and AIR  
c. Branch Allocated  
d. Category in which branch has been allocated  
 
Before depositing the hostel/mess fee, i t is the responsibility of the candidate to ensure that the 
information mentioned above is correctly shown in the portal and the candidate fulfils the 
eligibility criteria as mentioned in the prospectus published on website 
https://admission.thapar.edu . Any mismatch shall be reported immediately to the admission 
committee of the institute . 
 
In case of any discrepancy found during the document checking, his/her provisional admission 
shall stand cancelled.  
 
VENUE OF THE HOSTEL ALLOCATION  
Step – 1 - Hostel Allocation – LP-101/102  
Step – 2 - Fee Deposit - Institute Auditoriu m 
Step – 3 - Reporting in the respective hostel

The document also outlines the modes of payment for hostel and mess fees, recommending online payment methods for convenience. result.title: LIST OF DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (to be done tentatively in September, 2026)
result.summary: The partial document outlines the list of documents required for document verification for admissions, scheduled tentatively for September 2026. It includes a detailed list of documents such as the Admission Application Form, 10+2 examination certificate, Matriculation Certificate, JEE Mains 2026 Result Card, and various certificates and affidavits related to reserved categories, domicile, medical fitness, character, migration, income, anti-drugs/alcohol, anti-ragging, and study discontinuity. The document also mentions the commencement of the academic session on August 3, 2026, with a detailed academic calendar to be uploaded on the website.
